== DecipherCon 1999 identification (26 October 2026) ==
The player listed as the Swedish Star Trek CCG World Championship finalist at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (6th of 12 on Day 2, Decipher score sheet ST.03) is the same person as [[Johnny Ohlsson]]. Bill confirmed this identification on 26 October 2026. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 17:42, 26 October 2026 (UTC)
